title: The Last Boat
author: Mara Quill
style: Moody, rain-soaked, warm interiors against cold exteriors, soft film grain.

characters.name: Mara
characters.looks: Seventeen, small and wiry, dark curly hair tied with a red scarf, grey eyes, a yellow oilskin raincoat.
characters.voice: a girl, short sentences, dry, worried

characters.name: Tomas
characters.looks: Eighteen, tall and loud, freckles, a blue jumper.

places.name: The harbour wall
places.looks: A long stone pier at dusk, wet black stones, a rusted iron rail, fishing boats on grey water, the lighthouse beam across a purple sky.

scenes.background: Rain needles the grey water. The lighthouse beam sweeps over the boats.

shots.action: The pier at dusk, a small figure at its far end, the beam passing over her.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Every evening, Mara waited for the last boat.

shots.action: Mara grips the rusted rail, rain running off her hood.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: He said he'd be back before the lamp was lit.

shots.action: Tomas skids to a stop beside her, out of breath, grinning.
